documents.stance_why: The memo says "it is the instructor’s prerogative to allow or prohibit the use of any generative AI tool" and offers four example approaches (A to D) as a continuum, so it sets no stance itself and delegates.

documents.summary: A provost memo telling instructors that the allow-or-prohibit decision is theirs, that they must state it in every syllabus, and that students must attribute AI use. It supplies four sample policy tiers, three example rationales, and says unauthorized AI use is a Community Standards violation.
